span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Accommodating one's communication style to the interlocutor signals an attitude toward them and thereby steers how the speaker and the interaction are evaluated
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: An interaction partner that accommodates the user's needs signals attention and caring, which raises perceived social presence, which in turn produces enjoyment
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Matching the chatbot's communication style to the user's cognitive abilities lowers the cognitive effort the interaction demands and raises its efficiency, which drives re-use intention
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: The unequal split between rational and intuitive participants left that group underpowered, producing the absence of significant differences
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The pilot's sample was small and the authors treat the whole design as provisional pending a larger main study.
span.note: what this limits: everything reported: DESPITE ITS LIMITED SAMPLE SIZE, OUR PILOT STUDY OFFERS VALUABLE INSIGHTS - a pilot, treated as provisional pending the main study
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The within-subjects design may bias later user-experience responses; a between-subjects design is being considered instead.
span.note: what this limits: the user-experience responses specifically: IT IS WORTH CONSIDERING A BETWEEN-SUBJECTS DESIGN ... AS THIS PREVENTS PARTICIPANTS FROM BEING BIASED IN THEIR RESPONSES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The cognitive-style group was imbalanced (10 rational vs 4 intuitive), which may explain the absence of significant effects there.
span.note: what this limits: the null for cognitive style: A POSSIBLE EXPLANATION COULD BE THE IMBALANCE OF THE NUMBER OF PARTICIPANTS THAT WERE CLASSIFIED AS RATIONAL OR INTUITIVE (10 COMPARED TO 4)
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Only two user characteristics were studied, and separately; other characteristics and their combinations remain unexamined.
span.note: what this limits: the generality of the personalisation claim: only two user characteristics were studied, separately, so combinations remain untested
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The summarised benefit does not carry the exceptions the results report: in one group the adapted agent was no better on satisfaction, and the UN-adapted agent was rated higher on enjoyment.
span.note: what this limits: the conclusion that individualised CA design improves user experience: the results report two exceptions in the rational/intuitive cognitive style group, one of them favouring the un-adapted agent on enjoyment
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The design used may bias the responses it collects, and the authors say a different design would prevent it.
span.note: what this limits: these pilot ratings as unbiased measures of user experience: the authors state a within-subjects design was used and that a between-subjects design would prevent bias from previous questions
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Two user characteristics were examined, separately, and the authors state the interplay between them was not investigated.
span.note: what this limits: generalising to adaptation on user characteristics in general: two were examined separately, and their combinations and other CA design characteristics were not
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The constructs are measured entirely by item sets borrowed from other studies, so the measurement inherits whatever those instruments assume.
span.note: what this limits: these variables as directly observed: every construct is measured with item sets adopted from prior literature rather than developed or validated here
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
